source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            rows = [y for y, x in cells]
            cols = [x for y, x in cells]
            top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
            left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
            if (bottom - top == 2 and right - left == 2 and len(cells) == 9):
                blocks.append((top + 1, left + 1, color))

    assigned = {}
    for row, col, color in blocks:
        for x in range(w):
            assigned.setdefault((row, x), set()).add(color)
        for y in range(h):
            assigned.setdefault((y, col), set()).add(color)
    out = [list(row) for row in grid]
    for (r, c), colors in assigned.items():
        out[r][c] = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else 0
    return out
'''
